source: Run manifest of the lab's APOE R176C repeat-clone analysis (internal file paths omitted). Positions are in the analysis tool's trace window.
limits: The shared data do not include the donor sequences or which guide each clone received (the manifest says the assignment is unavailable). Donor windows here follow the paper's asymmetric 36/91 nt rule relative to each guide; the donor strand pairing follows the paper (donor = non-PAM strand) and the manifest's donor strands.
